title: Mage Class Identity — Spells & Talents
notes:
Strengthen the Mage's class identity through distinct Frost, Arcane, and Fire mechanics, with targeted buffs to improve viability without excessive increases in overall power.

Ice Block becomes a baseline level-25 spell with 3 sec of immunity and a 10 min cooldown. Improved Ice Block adds 7 sec, reduces the cooldown to 5 min, and heals for 30% of maximum health over the full 10 sec.

Ice Lance can discharge at any stack count: 0–4 stacks deal 25% of current base damage; 5 stacks deal 150%. Every cast consumes all stacks. The existing triple-damage proposal against Frozen targets is retained. Damage is initially tuned against the source's unmodified base damage, not a simulation with gear.

Burn Notice adds an Ignite-style rolling damage pool for repeated applications of each Fire damage over time effect. Flame Throwing and Improved Fire Ward exchange positions, making combined range talents cost more points.

Arcane Resilience replaces Arcane Shielding and moves to row 3, while Arcane Reach moves to row 4. Arcane Resilience reduces the duration and effectiveness of debuffs by 15%/25%. Mana Shield gains the full 33% mana-drain reduction as a baseline benefit at every rank.

Still open: Winter's Chill stack duration and spell-power scaling; Burn Notice stack limits, tick timing and cross-Mage pooling.

Lingering Frost is removed. Ice Walk no longer grants a movement speed bonus. Frost Spines replaces Frost Warding with active physical-hit retaliation: 22/44 base Frost damage at level 60. Its duration, cooldown, cost, lower-level progression and scaling remain open.

2-9.note: The original third-row Ice Lance is removed. A redesigned Ice Lance replaces Winter's Chill in the sixth row. Improved Blizzard now occupies the original Ice Lance slot.

2-12.name: Improved Ice Block
desc: Increases the duration of your Ice Block spell by 7 sec, reduces its cooldown by 5 min, and causes it to heal you for 30% of your maximum health over its duration.
2-12.note: Ice Block is now a baseline spell learned at level 25, granting 3 sec of immunity with a 10 min cooldown. With this talent, it lasts 10 sec, has a 5 min cooldown, and heals for 30% of maximum health over the full duration. Healing ends if Ice Block ends early.

2-2.name: Lingering Frost
2-2.note: Lingering Frost and its frost-trail movement speed bonus have been removed from the proposal. Ice Walk remains a separate utility talent without a movement speed bonus.

2-17.name: Ice Lance
desc:
Casting a Frost spell grants 1 stack of Winter's Chill, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Casting a non-Frost spell removes 1 stack. Ice Lance's damage is determined by the number of stacks you have before casting it. It consumes all stacks, leaving none remaining.

Deals 34 to 40 Frost damage and consumes all of your Winter's Chill stacks. Can be cast with any number of stacks, including none. At 5 stacks, deals 204 to 240 Frost damage instead. Deals triple damage against Frozen targets.
2-17.note: Damage shown for Rank 6, the highest spell rank available at level 60. Verified source: 136–160 base damage (Talents Forever, client 1.60.1.70170). Initial tuning: 25% damage at 0–4 stacks; 150% at 5 stacks. Values are rounded to whole damage. The proposal retains triple damage against Frozen targets; the beta's 300% increased damage is four times normal damage. Full-stack Frozen damage is therefore 12.5% above the beta before spell power and talents. Mana cost, range and instant cast are retained. Other spells below list all six rank damage values. Talent remains 1 rank; spell-power scaling and stack duration remain untuned.

2-0.name: Frost Spines
2-0.cost: Self · Duration, cooldown and mana cost to be determined
desc: Surrounds you with razor-sharp ice, dealing 22 Frost damage to enemies that strike you with physical attacks.
Surrounds you with razor-sharp ice, dealing 44 Frost damage to enemies that strike you with physical attacks.
2-0.note: Replaces Frost Warding with a self-cast active spell in row 1, column 1, retaining two talent ranks. Level-60 draft values are 22/44 base Frost damage per physical attack that hits you: 1x/2x the current unmodified maximum-rank Thorns damage (22), rather than Classic Era’s 18. This is flat retaliation damage and does not reduce incoming damage or reflect a percentage of it. Direct melee and ranged physical attacks trigger it; periodic damage does not. Duration, cooldown, mana cost, cast time, lower-level damage progression, spell-power scaling, absorbed-hit behavior, and interactions with other retaliation effects remain to be determined. Retaliation must not recursively trigger other retaliation effects. The former armor/resistance bonus and Frost Ward spell-reflection chance are removed. Source: https://wowforevertalents.com/abilities/druid/ and the saved Talents Forever client data, checked October 5, 2026.

1-4.note: Swapped with Improved Fire Ward. Now requires 15 points in earlier Fire rows, raising the investment required to combine this talent with Arcane Reach.

1-10.note: Swapped with Flame Throwing. Now requires 5 points in earlier Fire rows. Effect and rank count are unchanged.

1-6.note: Remains in row 3 alongside Burn Notice, Improved Flamestrike and Pyroblast. Moved to column 4 so all four talents fit. Effect, rank count and point gate are unchanged.

0-10.name: Arcane Resilience
desc: Reduces the duration and effectiveness of debuffs on you by 15%.
Reduces the duration and effectiveness of debuffs on you by 25%.
0-10.note: Replaces Arcane Shielding and swaps positions with Arcane Reach: row 3, column 1, requiring 10 points in earlier Arcane rows. Magical Precision remains in the original Arcane Resilience slot. The full 33% Mana Shield mana-drain reduction is now baseline. The former Mage Armor resistance bonus is removed with Arcane Shielding; no baseline Mage Armor change is proposed. Debuffs that have no scalable numerical effect still receive the duration reduction where applicable; detailed interaction rules remain to be defined.

spells.name: Ice Block
spells.meta: Baseline spell · Learned at level 25 · 15 Mana · Instant · 10 min cooldown
spells.original:
You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.
Original access: Frost talent, earliest level 25.
spells.proposed: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 3 sec. While encased, you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.
spells.note: Available to all Mages at level 25, matching the earliest level for the original fourth-row talent. Untalented Ice Block does not heal. Improved Ice Block extends the duration to 10 sec, reduces the cooldown to 5 min, and heals for 30% of maximum health over the full duration.

spells.name: Ice Lance
spells.meta: Talent-granted spell · Rank 6 values · 160 Mana · 30 yd range · Instant
spells.original: Deals 136 to 160 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets.
spells.proposed:
Deals 34 to 40 Frost damage and consumes all of your Winter's Chill stacks. Can be cast with any number of stacks, including none. At 5 stacks, deals 204 to 240 Frost damage instead. Deals triple damage against Frozen targets.

Casting a Frost spell grants 1 stack of Winter's Chill, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Casting a non-Frost spell removes 1 stack. Ice Lance's damage is determined by the number of stacks you have before casting it. It consumes all stacks, leaving none remaining.
spells.note:
Design tuning, not live beta values. At maximum spell rank: Frozen-target damage is 102–120 at 0–4 stacks or 612–720 at 5 stacks, compared with the current 544–640. Full-stack base damage is 50% higher on non-Frozen targets and 12.5% higher on Frozen targets. Spell-power coefficients are not tuned. Earlier spell ranks remain listed for comparison; access to the new sixth-row talent starts at level 35.

Rank 1 (source level 20): current 28–32; 0–4 stacks 7–8; 5 stacks 42–48.
Rank 2 (source level 28): current 34–40; 0–4 stacks 9–10; 5 stacks 51–60.
Rank 3 (source level 34): current 44–52; 0–4 stacks 11–13; 5 stacks 66–78.
Rank 4 (source level 42): current 76–90; 0–4 stacks 19–23; 5 stacks 114–135.
Rank 5 (source level 48): current 95–111; 0–4 stacks 24–28; 5 stacks 143–167.
Rank 6 (source level 56): current 136–160; 0–4 stacks 34–40; 5 stacks 204–240.

All source ranks, costs, and levels: Talents Forever data export, client 1.60.1.70170; checked October 5, 2026. Some other databases differ by 1 damage due to scaling or rounding; this proposal consistently uses the same source as the baseline.

With Burn Notice, reapplying Flamestrike adds any remaining periodic damage to the new application and refreshes its duration. Direct damage is unchanged.

spells.name: Ignite
spells.meta: Requires Ignite and Burn Notice · Maximum Ignite rank shown
spells.original: Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional 40% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.
spells.proposed:
Your critical strikes from Fire damage spells cause the target to burn for an additional 40% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.

With Burn Notice, a new Ignite adds any remaining Ignite damage to the new application and refreshes its duration.
spells.note: Uses the requested Ignite-style rolling pool. Damage is tracked per caster; shared pooling across multiple Mages has not been specified. Burn Notice does not grant Ignite or increase its damage percentage. Existing beta stacking behavior is not established by the source tooltip; this entry defines the proposal explicitly.

spells.name: Mana Shield
spells.meta: Baseline spell · Rank 6 shown · 140 Mana · Instant · First learned at level 20
spells.original: Absorbs 570 physical damage, draining mana instead. Drains 2 mana per damage absorbed. Lasts 1 min.
spells.proposed: Absorbs 570 physical damage, draining mana instead. Drains 1.34 mana per point of damage absorbed. Lasts 1 min.
spells.note: The full 2/2 Arcane Shielding mana-drain reduction (33%) is built into all ranks: 2 × 0.67 = 1.34 mana per damage absorbed. Absorption amounts, initial mana costs, duration, physical-only coverage, and learning levels are unchanged. Displayed at rank 6, learned at level 60. The old Mage Armor resistance bonus is not included in this Mana Shield change. Source: Talents Forever, client 1.60.1.70170.

spells.name: Conjure Water
spells.meta: Requires Arcane Meditation for bonus · Rank 7 shown
spells.original:
Conjures 10 bottles of crystal water, providing the mage and his allies with something to drink.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.
spells.proposed:
Conjures 10 bottles of crystal water, providing the mage and his allies with something to drink.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

With Arcane Meditation, your conjured water restores 10%/20%/30% more mana.
spells.note: The bonus depends on the conjuring Mage’s Arcane Meditation rank and benefits anyone drinking that water. Applies to every Conjure Water rank. Drinking duration, quantity conjured and spell costs are unchanged. This entry describes the talent benefit; without Arcane Meditation, Conjure Water is unchanged.

spells.name: Frostbite
spells.original: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec.
spells.proposed:
Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to trigger Frostbite, freezing the target for 5 sec.

You can toggle the freeze effect off to avoid rooting targets. Frostbite continues to trigger while the freeze effect is disabled, allowing Fingers of Frost to proc normally if learned.
spells.note: A convenience toggle for Frostbite’s root, not an aura or a dispellable buff. Turn the freeze effect off when you do not want to root a target. The underlying 5%/10%/15% trigger chance remains active, and each proc still grants Fingers of Frost if learned. Turning the freeze effect back on restores the 5 sec root. The toggle does not change the root’s dispel rules.

spells.name: Ice Walk
spells.meta: Talent-granted spell · 5 sec duration · 30 sec cooldown · Mana cost to be determined
spells.original: New proposal spell; not present in the beta snapshot.
spells.proposed:
Conjures a sheet of ice beneath your feet for 5 sec, allowing you to walk over water and through the air. Can be cast while falling.

Does not prevent falling damage. Landing on the ice after a long fall can be fatal.
spells.note:
Draft utility talent: 5 sec duration and 30 sec cooldown. 1 point beside Cold Snap, in row 5, column 3. Requires 20 points in earlier Frost rows. Ice forms beneath your feet as you move, supporting you over non-solid surfaces for the 5 sec duration, including after stepping off a ledge or casting in midair. Ice Walk does not increase movement speed. The ice acts as a landing surface: damage from the fall before landing is still applied and can kill you. When the effect ends over open air, you fall.

Still to design: mana cost, cast time, interaction with Cold Snap, how platform height behaves on slopes or while jumping, whether allies can use the ice, and interactions with mounts and other movement effects. The platform should not reset accumulated falling distance or provide an unintended fall-damage immunity.
